en.desktop1: Install the RBgrid extension in Claude Desktop on the computer you chat on (that computer needs internet; the hub doesn't).
en.desktop2: Open the file: Claude Desktop installs it. Leave «Hub address» empty: the assistant finds the hub itself. Only if it can't (VPN, guest Wi-Fi, another subnet), enter {url}
en.sayConnect: Then in the chat say «connect to my RBgrid». The assistant asks for a 6-digit code: it appears on top of this app, on any page.
